newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates ups Dubai-Sanaa flights from April 2.
newsitem.headline: Emirates ups Dubai-Sanaa flights from April 2.

text.p: Emirates said on Tuesday it will increase flights to Sanaa from two to three a week from April 2.
"Sanaa, one of our youngest routes, has been successful with cargo uplifted in particular exceeding our expectations," said Ghaith al-Ghaith, Emirates commercial operations director.
"We are pleased to be able to offer passengers and cargo customers the advantage of a third service," he said.
Emirates will fly the route with an Airbus A310. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
